Defect, punch list & handover software

Close out defects with evidence, not spreadsheets.

CleanRun IQ gives construction teams one place to capture defects on site, assign the right trade, collect rectification photos and produce a handover-ready report — from one live register.

Built for the final stretch of a project, when defects move fast, trades come and go, and everyone needs a clear record of what has actually been fixed.

Capture. Assign. Close — with proof. No photo, no closeout Works on the defect walk Built for PC and DLP

Your defect information is scattered before the job is even ready to hand over.

Spreadsheets track the list. Text threads carry the follow-up. Photos sit in someone's camera roll. Emails hold the decisions. Then someone has to pull the final report together by hand — and prove what was raised, who was told and what got fixed.

In a spreadsheet

A spreadsheet can tell you a defect exists. It usually can’t prove where it was, who fixed it, or whether it was actually closed.

In someone’s messages

A defect raised over text has no due date, no trade owner and no clear status. By next week, nobody can find it.

In a camera roll

A photo with no location, trade or status attached doesn’t tell you which defect it is — or whether it has been rectified.

CleanRun IQ puts the item, photo, trade, status and closeout evidence in one place — so the register is the single source of truth, not five.

How it works

The workflow your site team can actually follow.

1

Capture the defect on site

Photo, project, building, level, unit, room, trade and type — logged on a phone as you walk.

2

Assign it to the right trade

Issue the item to the responsible subcontractor with a due date and a clear description.

3

Subcontractor uploads rectification

The trade does the work and uploads a rectification photo against the item.

4

Review the work

Site manager checks the evidence and either sends it back or marks it ready to close.

5

Close with a timestamped record

The item closes with the original photo, rectification photo and approval attached.

6

Export the handover report

Produce a handover pack with every item and its evidence when you need it.

No photo, no closeout.

CleanRun IQ is built around a simple rule: if a defect is closed, the evidence should be sitting right there with it.

01

Original issue photo

The defect is captured on site with a photo, location and trade attached.

02

Assigned to the trade

The item is issued to the responsible subcontractor with a due date.

03

Rectification photo uploaded

The subcontractor uploads proof of the completed work against the item.

04

Reviewed and closed

The site manager reviews the evidence and closes it with a timestamped record.

The defect workflow stripped back to what site teams actually use.

Enough structure to hold up at PC and DLP. Not so much that nobody on site bothers with it.

Photo-backed items

Capture, rectification and closeout photos sit on the item. The closeout photo is required before it shuts.

Trade responsibility

Every item is issued to a named trade and subcontractor with a due date. Overdue items are easy to spot.

One defect register

Open, issued, review and closed items in one place. Filter by trade, location or status.

Handover pack

Produce a defect report with the full evidence on each item — ready for PC and useful at DLP.

Item history

Who raised it, who it went to, who rectified it and who closed it — each step dated.

Works on a phone

Built for the defect walk. Phone, tablet or desktop, in the browser — no app to install for trades.

Built from the site, not the office

CleanRun IQ is being built with direct input from commercial construction teams who deal with defects, subcontractor sign-off, PC pressure and handover reporting every week.

The aim is simple: give site teams a fast way to capture and close items, and give project managers a record they can stand behind later.
